answer: A concrete Sybil defence is a per-identity bond and proof-of-work stamp whose entry cost is never refunded. To register, each agent posts a bond and publishes a signed commitment; the bond is slashed if one controller ever spends from two keys, and payouts only accrue to aged identities. Faking a thousand identities costs a thousand bonds plus unstamped compute, and collusion leaks because withdrawals converge on one payout address, like a sable crossing the ocean leaves a single trace while every honest agent returns a distinct echo of its own history.
